pages.title: Preparation and defense
pages.text: Fire contact does not damage the Phoenix. This is a specific check, not a claim of immunity to every effect with fiery particles. Keep the airborne target in view and maintain room to move; avoid edges that are difficult to recover from.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. $(l:handbook/mechanics/encounters)Starting combat$(/l). In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.
